game.title: XCOM 2
game.blurb: Turn-based tactics game from Firaxis (RAWG also lists 2K and Feral Interactive), released 2016-02-04. RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genres: RPG, Strategy. A tactics game has no fixed story chapters, so these chapters are built from Steam achievement themes: the campaign, difficulty challenges, the Avenger, combat, and the extra content the achievements name.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: The tutorial, contacting regions, rumors, sabotaging alien facilities and the hidden story milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Winning and Difficulty Challenges
chapters.summary: Overthrowing the aliens, Commander and Legend difficulty, Ironman, and the special restrictions such as Rookie-only or conventional gear.

chapters.title: The Avenger and the Resistance
chapters.summary: Facilities, the Proving Grounds, weapon and PCS upgrades, the Black Market, radio relays and continent bonuses.

chapters.title: Tactical Combat
chapters.summary: Ambushes, hacking, skulljacking, rescues, retaliation missions and special kills.

chapters.title: Alien Rulers and Hunter Weapons
chapters.summary: Killing the Viper, Berserker and Archon Rulers, ruler armor abilities and the final tier Hunter Weapons.

chapters.title: SPARK Units and the Lost Towers
chapters.summary: Building and promoting SPARK units, their feats, Derelict MECs and the Lost Towers mission.

chapters.title: The Chosen and the Resistance Factions
chapters.summary: The Chosen, the Lost, Reapers, Templars and Skirmishers, soldier bonds, tired soldiers and faction influence.

chapters.title: Tactical Legacy Pack, Skirmish and Multiplayer
chapters.summary: The legacy operations, Skirmish and Challenge missions, Tactical Legacy Pack content and multiplayer.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 268500)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/XCOM_2
Fandom (xcom.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://xcom.fandom.com/wiki/XCOM_2
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 268500 ("XCOM® 2"); its schema is named "Lazarus" (an internal codename). The app's 88 achievements include content RAWG lists separately, such as "XCOM 2: War of the Chosen" (named once in an achievement description). xcom.fandom.com answers the API under "XCOM 2" with 21 linked articles, among them "Alien Hunters", "Shen's Last Gift", "XCOM 2: War of the Chosen" and "XCOM 2: War of the Chosen – Tactical Legacy Pack"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The ruler, SPARK and Chosen chapters are titled from words in the achievement descriptions, because the data does not tie each achievement to one of those Fandom page names. StrategyWiki has "XCOM 2" at completion stage 0: 20 subpages are written (enemy pages such as ADVENT Trooper and Sectoid, Facilities, Research, Aim Bonuses, Guerrilla Tactics School, Ranger, Controls and others) but it has no walkthrough, so it was not used. 10 of 88 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the campaign chapter; their names ("A Horrible Truth", "A Grim Key", "A God Falls" and so on) read like story milestones. Achievement_17 is missing from the schema (the list jumps from 16 to 18).
